changes.why: The 'Adjusted' incidence in Table 1 corrects cited study estimates for under-ascertainment (blood-culture sensitivity, care seeking); it is a measurement correction, not a comparison within levels of a third variable or a covariate-adjusted contrast.

ev.q: Countries report data on selected vaccine-preventable diseases to WHO and UNICEF annually using the electronic Joint Reporting Form (eJRF).

changes.why: Regional and site incidence are set side by side from cited studies and models; no group-level exposure-outcome analysis is made, so ecologic does not apply.

equity.level_reason: No results are reported by a social-position dimension of people. Country income group frames where typhoid is endemic (population), and the age-group ranking of GBD incidence has no social-position framing.

level_alternative.reason: Country income and Gavi eligibility could be read as an SES descriptor, with financial barriers for middle-income countries raised in the discussion.

notes: Nearly all quantities (GBD, SEAP, STRATAA, SETA, VE, coverage) are cited from other studies; the report compiles them. The new figures are eJRF reported-case counts and 3 of 44 high-incidence countries (7%) introducing TCV.
